pages.text: [[Per cent]] means out of every hundred. 15 of these 100 squares are shaded, so that is 15%. As a fraction it is 15/100, and as a decimal 0.15.

pages.name: 3% as a decimal
pages.why: 3% is 3 out of 100, which is 3/100. Dividing 3 by 100 gives 0.03. Dividing by 10 instead gives 0.3, which would be 30 squares, or 30%.

pages.task: Put it together. What is 7.5% of £80?
pages.why: 7.5% is 7.5/100, which is 0.075. So 7.5% of £80 is 80 × 0.075 = £6. As a check, 10% is £8, and 7.5% is a bit less.
